title: Sye Raa Narasimha Reddy
desc: Uyyalawada Narasimha Reddy, the ruler of the Rayalaseema region, resists the tyranny of the East India Company and sparks a revolution in the process.

title: Zombie
desc: Tired of their day-to-day lives, three friends decide to go on a vacation where they encounter zombies and meet a girl while running for their lives.

title: Naiyaandi
desc: Chinna and Vanaroja are in love, but in an unexpected turn of events, her marriage is fixed with someone else. Vanaroja escapes and comes to live with Chinna's family, but his brothers fall for her.

title: Charlie Chaplin
desc: When Ramakrishnan is caught with a prostitute, he introduces her to his wife as Thiru's girlfriend. Thiru, feeling helpless, goes along with the plan at the cost of upsetting his own girlfriend, Susi.
